metadata.purpose: Research-derived 9-hole routing and cautiously estimated tee data for import into a golf visualizer.

scorecard_verification.course_identity: The club describes a separate nine-hole short course; 1Golf and GolfPass identify it as a Par-27/Par-3 course.
scorecard_verification.lengths: GolfPass shows Yellow per-hole values [136,96,82,125,100,70,111,96,116] m and Red [115,78,64,103,90,60,90,74,96] m. Its rounded individual cells total 933/770 m while the tee totals shown are 936/776 m. The club prose says holes are 60–120 m, which conflicts with GolfPass Yellow hole 1 at 136 m.
scorecard_verification.stroke_index: GolfPass shows HCP 1–9, but no independent source was found. Generic stroke_index is intentionally null.

gps_provenance.source: 18Birdies public serialized course profile, Veckefjardens (Par 3) course entry
gps_provenance.exactness: Nine coherent public routes, but no direct coloured teeGeoPoints. These are third-party route geometries, not a surveyed club export.
gps_provenance.validation: The public route endpoints form a coherent nine-hole loop; end-to-next-start transitions range from 17.5 to 74.9 m. Each route is 13.3–17.2 m longer than the corresponding GolfPass Yellow length, consistently suggesting a source route start behind the listed Yellow tee.
gps_provenance.excluded_data: GolfTraxx public Par-3 static pages resolved to main 18-hole-course values, so they were deliberately excluded from all spatial data.

import_guidance.tee_estimate_method: Each estimate is interpolated along the public route so its along-route distance to the green endpoint proxy equals the displayed GolfPass per-hole length. It assumes the public route begins at a back-tee-side point and follows the current hole path.
import_guidance.do_not_promote: Do not treat estimates as field-verified tee locations or proxies as exact green centre/front/back without new club or field evidence.
